raised_by: owner DraftKings board capture at 6:07 PM PT (2026-08-23T01:07Z) showing live game states
severity: DATA_DEFECT_IN_REGISTERED_PROVENANCE — the registrations themselves remain VALID
what_the_board_showed: CIN@AZ live in the 4th inning with 0 out; CLE@COL live in the 4th with 2 outs; MIN@SD live in the 2nd with 1 out — all at 01:07Z.
the_contradiction: I registered CIN@AZ with first_pitch_utc 03:10:00Z and CLE@COL with 02:10:00Z. A game cannot be in the 4th inning at 01:07Z if first pitch is still two or three hours away. Both recorded times are refuted outright by the board.

reconstruction_from_the_live_state.method: innings elapsed x 13-16 minutes per inning, back-projected from the 01:07Z board

REGISTRATIONS_REMAIN_VALID: All three forecasts were appended at 2026-08-22T23:56:22Z, which is EARLIER than every reconstructed first pitch (00:08Z at the earliest). No post-start registration occurred and no forecast needs quarantining. This was checked before anything else, because a post-start registration would have been a contract breach requiring immediate exclusion.
WHAT_IS_WRONG: The provenance fields are false. registered_minutes_before_first_pitch was recorded as T-134m for CLE@COL and T-194m for CIN@AZ. The true margins were approximately T-12m to T-23m and T-23m to T-32m. The registrations were comfortable on paper and thin in reality — a roughly ten-fold overstatement of the safety margin.
ROOT_CAUSE: I took the start times from SEARCH PROSE — 'first pitch scheduled for 8:10 pm in Denver' and '8:10 pm in Phoenix' — one turn after establishing that whole-slate prose is unreliable and that per-game corroboration by publisher titles, URL slugs and venue strings is the method that works. I then applied prose to the single most timing-critical field in the pipeline. The lesson had been written and was not applied where it mattered most.
WHY_IT_MATTERS_BEYOND_TONIGHT: Registration margin is the control that keeps a pregame forecast pregame. A metadata field that overstates it by two hours would, on a slightly different night, let a post-start registration pass a review that checks the recorded margin rather than the observed game state. The defect is in the evidence, not the arithmetic, so no gate caught it — only an external observation did.
CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS: This record supersedes the first_pitch_utc and registered_minutes_before_first_pitch fields on P4-20260822-CLE@COL and P4-20260822-CIN@AZ append-only. The forecast rows themselves are immutable and are NOT edited (R3/R6).
Start times sourced from prose must be labelled TIER_3_PROSE and may not populate a timing field that a gate relies on. A start time needs the same per-game corroboration the schedule itself needs.
Proposed gate: at settlement, reconcile every registered first_pitch_utc against the observed final/live state and flag any registration whose recorded margin cannot be reconciled.
